articles.title: Anthropic IPO Raises $107.3 Billion to Top SpaceX’s Record Debut
articles.summary: Anthropic PBC and its seven co-founders raised a record $107.3 billion in an upsized IPO and private placement, becoming the first frontier AI lab to tap public markets for the development of thinking machines.

articles.title: Nvidia Turmoil Spurs Valuation Rethink of Japan’s AI Shares
articles.summary: Japanese stocks that once commanded a premium for their exposure to artificial intelligence are now looking too risky, with Jensen Huang’s abrupt departure from Nvidia Corp. adding to concerns about the industry’s outlook, investors say.

articles.title: Anthropic IPO Raises $3 Billion in Japan, Lower End of Range
articles.summary: Anthropic PBC raised about $3 billion from Japanese investors as part of its initial public offering, the lower end of its planned range, according to a regulatory filing on Thursday.

articles.title: Anthropic IPO Hands SK Hynix Tycoon’s Firm $3 Billion Windfall
articles.summary: Anthropic PBC’s blockbuster initial public offering has delivered a multibillion-dollar windfall for billionaire Chey Tae-won’s empire, rewarding an early bet on the artificial-intelligence startup by SK Telecom Co., South Korea’s largest mobile carrier.

articles.title: Nvidia Sizes Up Arm CEO Haas in Search for Huang Successor
articles.summary: Nvidia Corp. recruiting firm Heidrick & Struggles approached Arm Holdings Plc Chief Executive Officer Rene Haas as part of its hunt for a new leader, stepping up efforts to move on from longtime CEO Jensen Huang.

articles.title: Blue Owl Plans $513 Million CMBS for Amazon-Leased Data Center
articles.summary: Blue Owl Capital Inc. is preparing to sell $513 million of commercial mortgage backed securities to fund the acquisition of a Northern Virginia data center that’s fully leased to Amazon.com Inc., according to people with knowledge of the matter.

articles.title: Bitcoin Erases Bessent Rally as Leverage and Liquidity Fade
articles.summary: Bitcoin has erased all the gains from its late-summer rally as fading risk appetite and the record hack at exchange Binance drove investors to retreat, leaving the largest token trading in a thinner market increasingly vulnerable to sharp price swings.
